description: A string embedded into an OBJECT or ARRAY keeps its EXACT whitespace - a script or code value legitimately ends in a newline, and round-tripping it through OBJECT_CONSTRUCT must not trim it, which silently corrupted stored code blocks so they no longer compared equal to the source. Leading and trailing spaces survive ARRAY_CONSTRUCT the same way, and the whitespace is still there after extraction. A VARIANT JSON null embeds back as a real JSON null and the pair is KEPT, matching Snowflake's handling of a VARIANT-null value. Converted 1:1 from functions/ObjectConstructWhitespaceTest (now retired); the extraction round trip is stringified with '<' || x || '>' so a trailing newline is visible in the assertion, and the ARRAY results read through TO_JSON so the HTTP transport's comma spacing cannot reach them.

steps.sql:
SELECT '<' || OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('v', 'ends with newline
'):v::VARCHAR || '>' AS s
